invariants.rationale: config is used for field and method access in every return branch.
createIndex returns new objects or results from static methods that return non-null for supported cases.
Return value must be instance of HoodieIndex, as per static method signature.
If config.getIndexClass is not null/empty, the result is the user-defined index.
If not returning from the user-defined branch, config.getIndexType() is used in the switch.
